name: regression-suite-error
about: A regression run where every test that ran passed but a suite did not run (docs/decisions/2026-10-18-regression-trigger.md): the demo repo's scripts/e2e reports two web passes and a mobile suite with status error (its emulator did not boot). The run is failed, not passed: #loop gets one red message with the suite's error line, and there is nothing to file.

data.error: suite mobile: the emulator did not boot

messages.text: (?s)^\*Regression R1 \(web\) :red_circle: failed\*: 2 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped · jarvis-server `[0-9a-f]{7}` · full report: /board/regressions/1 on loopd\n.*suite mobile: the emulator did not boot \(adb wait-for-device timed out\)
